hooks.command: file="$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.ts$'; then cd packages/dss-api && npx prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null && npx eslint --fix "$file" 2>/dev/null; fi
file="$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(c4|likec4)$'; then cd docs/architecture/c4 && npx likec4 validate 2>&1; fi
file="$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.spec\.ts$'; then cd packages/dss-api && npx vitest run "$file" --reporter=verbose 2>&1; fi
